description: Source code for hardware reset cause management for NXP i.MX MCUX platform, including functions to get, clear, and support reset causes.

methods.name: z_impl_hwinfo_get_reset_cause
methods.description: Retrieves the reset cause flags from hardware registers and sets the cause accordingly.

methods.name: z_impl_hwinfo_clear_reset_cause
methods.description: Clears the reset cause flags in hardware registers.

methods.name: z_impl_hwinfo_get_supported_reset_cause
methods.description: Returns the supported reset causes as a bitmask.
